blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT means Information Technology. It is the set of tools, systems and people that keep a company's information flowing. Every email, every spreadsheet, every payment and every video call depends on IT working quietly in the background.

When IT works, nobody notices. When it breaks, everybody notices immediately. So IT is not just a back-office service. It is a core part of how the business makes money, serves customers, and stays safe.

The leaders who understand this invest in IT deliberately. The leaders who still call it 'the computer people' are often surprised — usually at the worst possible moment.

items.q: What does IT mean?
items.why: "IT means Information Technology."

items.q: According to the text, what does IT do?
items.why: "tools, systems and people that keep a company's information flowing."

items.q: When does everybody notice IT?
items.why: "When it breaks, everybody notices immediately."

items.q: The text suggests that a leader who calls IT 'the computer people'…
options: does not see IT as important
items.why: Inferência: o texto contrasta esse líder com quem investe em TI; ele subestima a área.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: IT is only a back-office service
IT helps the business make money
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que TI NÃO é só retaguarda — é parte central do negócio.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando ao novo colega por que a TI é estratégica. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. Let me tell you one thing about this company. We do not think of IT as 'the printer people'. IT is strategic here.

Look around you. Every email you send, every payment we make, every video call with a client — all of it runs on IT. When it works, you do not think about it. It is quiet. But when it stops, the whole floor stops with it.

Last year a system went down for two hours. We could not send invoices. We could not talk to customers. Two hours felt like a very long day. After that, the board changed its mind. Now we invest in IT deliberately, not by accident.

So my advice is simple. When the IT team asks for time or money, listen carefully. They are not just fixing computers. They are keeping the business alive and safe. Treat them as partners, and you will do well here.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does this company think of IT?
items.why: "We do not think of IT as 'the printer people'. IT is strategic here."

items.q: What happened last year?
options: A system went down for two hours
items.why: "Last year a system went down for two hours."

items.q: What could the company NOT do during the problem?
options: Send invoices or talk to customers
items.why: "We could not send invoices. We could not talk to customers."

items.q: Why does James tell this story to the new joiner?
options: To show that IT really matters to the business
To complain about the IT team
To ask for a new computer
To explain how to fix a printer
items.why: Inferência: a história do problema de duas horas prova que a TI é essencial.

items.q: How does James want the new joiner to treat the IT team?
items.why: Inferência: "Treat them as partners" — ele quer respeito e cooperação com a TI.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "A laptop is a useful tool for remote work." A tool is…
options: something you use to do a job
items.why: Tool = ferramenta: algo que você usa para fazer um trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When the payment ___ stops, we cannot send money to suppliers."
items.why: System = sistema; é o sistema de pagamento que para.

items.q: "Good IT helps information flow between teams." To flow means to…
options: move easily from one place to another
items.why: To flow = fluir: mover-se com facilidade de um lugar a outro.

items.q: "We had a video call with the client in London." A video call is…
options: a meeting with sound and picture on a screen
items.why: Video call = videochamada: reunião com imagem e som na tela.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Smart leaders invest in IT ___, not by accident."
items.why: Deliberately = deliberadamente, de propósito — o oposto de "por acidente".

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs comuns em conversas de trabalho sobre TI. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The new system went down for two hours." To go down means to…
items.why: Go down = cair, parar de funcionar (sistema, site, servidor).

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the new software." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new email system next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, implementar algo novo para os usuários.

items.q: "Please back up your files before the update." To back up means to…
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança dos arquivos.

items.q: "Can you log in to the system with your password?" To log in means to…
items.why: Log in = entrar/acessar a conta com usuário e senha.
